Generate them by re-running ./setup.sh --force (needs Node.js installed), or add VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY + VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY to webapp/docker/.env, then restart the webapp container.

devices.presenceHelpDescription: How to connect an LD2410 radar sensor with Kinboard
devices.presenceHelpStep1Body: You need an <bold>LD2410 radar sensor</bold> connected to a Raspberry Pi via UART (GPIO 14/15). The sensor detects people through walls up to ~5m away.
devices.presenceHelpStep2Body: Install the Python script presence_detector.py on the Raspberry Pi. It reads the sensor and sends the data to the webapp.
devices.presenceHelpStep3Body: Enable the presence sensor for your kiosk device (toggle with radar icon). The device ID will appear — copy it with the button and paste it into the Python script.
devices.presenceHelpStep4Body: To test without hardware you can use the <bold>Presence Simulator</bold>:
devices.presenceHelpStep5BulletMode: <bold>Control mode:</bold> Screensaver only or display off (DPMS)
devices.presenceHelpTip: <bold>Tip:</bold> The sensor reports its status roughly every second. If it shows “No connection” in settings, check that the script is running and uses the correct device ID.

people.title: Who's in your family?
people.description: Add the people whose calendars, shopping, and meals this dashboard tracks. You can change colors, add avatars, or invite more later in Settings → People.
people.saveError: Couldn't save family members. Try again.

calendar.title: Add a calendar
calendar.description: The family calendar is the heart of Kinboard. Connect Google for two-way sync, or paste an iCal (.ics) link for read-only feeds like school terms or holidays. You can skip this and add calendars anytime from Settings.
calendar.googleBody: Two-way sync — events you add in Kinboard push back to Google. Needs a one-time OAuth connect in Settings.
calendar.urlHint: Works with iCloud Family Sharing, Google's secret iCal address, and most CalDAV providers.
calendar.saveError: Couldn't save the calendar. Check the URL and try again.

homeassistant.title: Connect Home Assistant
homeassistant.description: Optional. If you have a Home Assistant instance, paste its URL and a long-lived access token. Without this, the smart-home and energy pages stay empty (you can connect later from Settings).
homeassistant.fail: Couldn't reach that URL with that token. Double-check both.

weather.title: Set your location
weather.description: Pick a city so the dashboard's weather widget knows where to look. Forecast and the location-resolver use the OpenWeatherMap free tier.
weather.apiKeyBody: Weather stays disabled until a key is configured — you can also do this later. Free key from openweathermap.org/api.
weather.saveError: Couldn't save your location. Try again.
